## Acceptance and quality checks

- [ ] Automated tests / appropriate integration tests passed.

- [ ] Backward compatibility, data mapping and auditability checked as applicable.
- [ ] Documentation / release notes updated as appropriate.

## Disclosure checklist
- [ ] No case/victim/banking personal data, actual evidence or transaction details.
- [ ] No secrets, internal endpoints, infrastructure values, live logs or sensitive configuration.
- [ ] No vulnerability details or controlled contract annexes.
- [ ] Sensitive acceptance evidence is referenced only from approved restricted systems.

> A merged PR is not automatically a Done story, UAT sign-off or TOR contractual acceptance.
